## Ledger — the hotcrm changesets pair landed (director seat, 2026-09-07)

Following the 12-hour PR audit and the maintainer's question *"pr 绿了为什么不合并"*.

### Merged

| PR | merged (UTC) | method | files | what it fixes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| hotcrm **#1739** | 14:11:11 | queue, squash → `e735d00d` | 3 | `changeset version` re-formatted already-shipped `CHANGELOG.md` through Prettier on every run; repairs the one line that cost (`due*date` → `due_date`, `related_to*\*` → `related_to_*` at :1135) |
| hotcrm **#1740** | 14:26:16 | queue, squash → `6d9fd0a4` | 9 | takes `@changesets/cli` to 3.x with the config its breaking changes require; supersedes dependabot PR #1264 |

Both went through the merge queue. Recorded for the operational log: **hotcrm
enforces "Changes must be made through the merge queue" the same as objectstack
and objectui** — a direct merge returns `405 Repository rule violations found`;
`enable_pr_auto_merge` is the way in.

### Why they sat green and unmerged

Not a technical blocker. **hotcrm's `AGENTS.md` states no seat-merge posture for
non-governed PRs**, where objectstack and objectui both do. The director seat
treated the silence as "no authorisation" and held. Carded as **hotcrm#1742**;
until it is ruled, the same hold will recur on every green hotcrm PR.

### The conflict #1740 hit, and the finding underneath it

#1739 landed as a **squash**, so its own commit stopped being an ancestor of
`main` and #1740 — stacked on #1739's branch — went `dirty` on retarget. One
file conflicted: `.changeset/config.json`, `prettier: false` (main) against
`format: false` (branch). Resolved by merging `main` into the branch (no rebase,
no force-push) and taking the branch side.

⭐ **The measured reason that is worth carrying forward.** 3.x removed the
`prettier` key and renamed it `format`. A leftover `prettier` key is not
rejected and not warned about. Through the installed `@changesets/config` 4.0.0
validator, `main`'s side of that hunk resolves to:

```
errors   : undefined
warnings : []                                        <- accepted in silence
config.format          = "auto"                      <- formatting BACK ON
config.privatePackages = {version:false, tag:false}  <- hotcrm stops versioning itself
```

versus the resolved tree's `format = false`,
`privatePackages = {version:true, tag:false}`.

Had the conflict gone the other way, **#1739's fix would have been silently
undone and `hotcrm` would have stopped bumping its own version — with CI green
and `changeset version` printing "All files have been updated"**. The general
rule, filed here because it is not specific to changesets:

> **When a config key is renamed, the dangerous case is the old name being
> ignored rather than rejected.** A correct fix expressed under the old name
> becomes a no-op at the next major, and nothing in CI or the tool's own output
> says so. Any dependency major that renames a key we set needs the new name
> read back out of the installed validator, not off the release notes.

Verify at the merged tree: `pnpm verify` exit 0, 162 test files / 3420 passed,
1 skipped. Lockfile moves 33 identities, all `@changesets/*` / `@manypkg/*` /
`@clack/*` and small transitives; zero diff lines touch `@objectstack/*`,
vitest, playwright or typescript — deliberately checked after the objectui
lockfile-regeneration regressions (objectui#8326).
